prompt: clang PowerPC mcrbits CR-bit tracking optimization level enabled
answer: Clang’s PowerPC CR-bit tracking optimization is enabled by default at **-O2 and higher**. It is disabled by default at **-O0 and -O1**. The `-mcrbits` and `-mno-crbits` flags can override the default.
